scope: Independent synthetic challenge, not real-factory validation
registration: Criteria and seeds fixed before improved-model evaluation. A challenge used to change a model becomes development data; a new final seed/protocol is then required.

render_gate.purpose: Paired actual Gazebo rendering and label geometry preflight; no model predictions or scores

pre_evaluation_amendment.reason: Actual Gazebo motor-settling probe reached a 100 rad/s limit when commanding higher RPM; rejected before any dataset samples, new training or challenge evaluation.
pre_evaluation_amendment.scope: Hardware/simulator feasibility correction before evaluation; thresholds, seed and sample-selection rule unchanged. Collection requires observed RPM settling, never commanded-RPM substitution.

status_definitions.FAIL: Corrupt/inconsistent data, split-group reuse, a changed frozen artifact, or incomplete versioned provenance.
status_definitions.WARN: Observed shortcut dependence, domain coverage gap, or performance below a predeclared synthetic QA criterion; not proof of bias absence/presence in every domain.
status_definitions.UNVALIDATED: No independent real-factory data and labels are available. Synthetic checks cannot clear this status.
